Write the actual text of a professional message to my fitness trainer following my standard fitness summary format established in my previous quarterly reviews. Using the data aggregation approach from my earlier fitness exports, extract and present specific Q1 metrics from fitness_export_Q1.csv as definitive figures—total training volume, intensity trends, consistency rate, and progression benchmarks with exact numbers, no ranges or uncertainty disclaimers. Ask for her specific recommendations regarding: (1) objective markers that should trigger deloads vs. intensity weeks, (2) minimum effective dose protocols for high-stress work
